# Stages: the networks in time (online) against DFG on the n axis (generated by order_report.py)

Network stages: Part 5's rule (onset steps of the seed-mean learned fraction, online; onsets within a factor 1.35 form one stage). DFG stages: characters grouped by the smallest grid n from which DFG's final least-squares function carries them (learned fraction >= 1/2 for good), median of seeds 0-2, and for seed 0 alone. For rmaj9, dlist5 and dnf3 a stage lists counts of characters by degree (and |yhat| where a degree has several).
